sentence.subtitle: Ask what it means here, in plain English
sentence.sentenceTranslation: Do you have plans for Saturday?
sentence.answer:
Here “para” points to when the plans are for: Saturday.

Use “para” for a deadline or a purpose — “para el lunes” (by Monday), “para aprender” (in order to learn).

Example: ¿Qué planes tienes para el verano? — What are your plans for the summer?
